rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The accusation targets chaste, heedless women, like Aisha, who was unaware of the indecency alleged against her.
rows.anchor: المحصنات الغافلات } عن الفواحش، كغفلة عائشة رضي الله عنها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who accuse them are cursed and punished with lashes in this world and fire in the next.
rows.anchor: لعنوا } عذبوا { في الدنيا } بالجلد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God fully gives them their due recompense; then they know He is manifest truth because He had made true His worldly promises.
rows.anchor: جزاءهم الواجب { ويعلمون أن الله هو الحق المبين } لأنه قد بين لهم حقيقة ما كان يعدهم به في الدنيا.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: On the speech reading, vile words are for vile men and vile people for vile words; good words are for good people and good people for good words.
rows.anchor: الخبيثات } من القول. وقيل: من النساء { للخبيثين } من الرجال { والخبيثون } من الناس { للخبيثات } من القول.

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: An alternative reads the feminine terms as vile and good women, and the final good ones as good people.
rows.anchor: وقيل: من النساء { للطيبين } من الناس { والطيبون } من الناس { للطيبات } من القول. وقيل: من الناس.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The purified people are Aisha and Safwan, cleared of the accusations made by wicked slanderers.
rows.anchor: أولئك } يعني: عائشة وصفوان { مبرؤون مما يقولون } يقوله أهل الخبث والقاذفون.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The people of Paradise have a better dwelling place and a better place for the midday rest.
rows.anchor: أصحاب الجنة يومئذ خير مستقرا } موضع قرار { وأحسن مقيلا } موضع قيلولة.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The cloud is thin, white cloud, and the angels descend to honor the believers.
rows.anchor: عن الغمام، وهو السحاب الأبيض الرقيق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: On that day the true sovereignty belongs to the Most Merciful.
rows.anchor: الملك يومئذ الحق } أي: الملك الذي هو الملك حقا ملك الرحمن يومئذ.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Most of them hear without understanding and do not reason in their hearts about the message; they resemble livestock in ignorance of signs and evidence.
rows.anchor: أكثرهم يسمعون } سماع تفهيم { أو يعقلون } بقلوبهم ما تقول لهم:

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They are worse than livestock because livestock follow their caretaker, whereas these people disobey their beneficent master.
rows.anchor: لأن النعم تنقاد لمن يتعهده، وهم لا يطيعون مولاهم الذي أنعم عليهم.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The shadow stretches from dawn until sunrise; God could have made it permanently still, and the sun serves as its guide because it makes the shadow known.
rows.anchor: لجعل الظل { ساكنا } ثابتا دائما { ثم جعلنا الشمس عليه دليلا } لأن بالشمس يعرف الظل.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God draws the shadow back as the sun rises.
rows.anchor: ثم قبضناه } قبضنا الظل إلينا بارتفاع الشمس { قبضا يسيرا } قيل: خفيا.

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: One reported reading takes the gradual withdrawal as faint or hidden.
rows.anchor: قبضنا الظل إلينا بارتفاع الشمس { قبضا يسيرا } قيل: خفيا.

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Another reported reading takes the withdrawal as easy.
rows.anchor: قبضنا الظل إلينا بارتفاع الشمس { قبضا يسيرا } قيل: خفيا. وقيل: سهلا.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Night covers people, sleep rests their bodies, and daytime lets them spread out after sleep.
rows.anchor: النوم سباتا } راحة لأبدانكم { وجعل النهار نشورا } حياة تنتشرون فيه من النوم.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The uninformed person should ask an expert who can describe God's attributes.
rows.anchor: فاسأل أيها الإنسان الذي لا تعلم صفته خبيرا يخبرك بصفاته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Most Merciful is God's name; the polytheists did not know it, so they objected to prostrating to the one Muhammad commanded them to worship.
rows.anchor: للرحمن } وهو اسم الله سبحانه، كانوا لا يعرفونه لذلك قالوا: { وما الرحمن أنسجد لما تأمرنا } أنت يا محمد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The command to prostrate to the Most Merciful made them turn still farther away from faith.
rows.anchor: وزادهم } قول القائل لهم: اسجدوا للرحمن { نفورا } عن الإيمان.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses's chest tightens from their denial and his tongue cannot deliver the message because of the knot in his mouth, so he asks Aaron to help him convey it.
rows.anchor: ويضيق صدري } من تكذيبهم إياي { ولا ينطلق لساني } بأداء الرسالة للعقدة التي في فيه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses says he is accused of the crime of killing the Copt.
rows.anchor: ولهم علي ذنب } بقتل القبطي.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God reassures Moses and Aaron that they will not be killed and promises support, hearing what they say and what is said to them.
rows.anchor: قال كلا } لا يقتلونك { إنا معكم } بالنصرة { مستمعون } نسمع ما تقول ويقال لك.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The singular noun “messenger” describes the two messengers together, who have a mission from the Lord of the worlds.
rows.anchor: فأتيا فرعون فقولا إنا رسول } ذوا رسالة { رب العالمين }.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The request to send the Children of Israel with them is explained in Surat Ta Ha; Pharaoh recognized Moses when Moses brought the message.
rows.anchor: أن أرسل معنا بني إسرائيل } مفسر في سورة طه، فلما أتاه بالرسالة عرفه فرعون.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Pharaoh says he raised Moses as a child among his people and that Moses lived there for thirty years.
rows.anchor: ألم نربك فينا وليدا } صبيا { ولبثت فينا من عمرك سنين } ثلاثين سنة.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Pharaoh identifies the deed as killing the Copt and accuses Moses of denying the favor Pharaoh bestowed on him.
rows.anchor: وفعلت فعلتك التي فعلت } يعني: قتل القبطي { وأنت من الكافرين } الجاحدين لنعمتي عليك.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses says he acted while ignorant, before anything from God had come to him.
rows.anchor: قال } موسى: { فعلتها إذا وأنا من الضالين } الجاهلين، لم يأتني من الله شيء.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses acknowledges Pharaoh's favor in raising him, but says it was a favor only because Pharaoh did not enslave him as he enslaved Israel's children; “enslaved” means made into slaves.
rows.anchor: هي نعمة إذ ربيتني ولم تستعبدني كاستعبادك بني إسرائيل. و { عبدت } معناه: اتخذت عبيدا.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Pharaoh asks what sort of thing the Lord of the worlds is, whom Moses claims sent him.
rows.anchor: أي شيء رب العالمين الذي تزعم أنك رسوله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses identifies the Lord as creator of the heavens, earth, and what lies between them, if Pharaoh's audience is certain of this.
rows.anchor: رب السموات والأرض وما بينهما إن كنتم موقنين } أنه خالقهما.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Pharaoh speaks to the nobles around him in amazement, asking whether they hear Moses.
rows.anchor: لمن حوله } من أشراف قومه معجبا لهم: { ألا تستمعون } إلى ما يقوله: موسى؟!

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses answers that God is the lord of Pharaoh and his earliest forefathers.
rows.anchor: ربكم ورب آبائكم الأولين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Pharaoh calls Moses mad, saying he speaks about things whose truth they cannot know.
rows.anchor: إن رسولكم الذي أرسل إليكم لمجنون } يتكلم بكلام لا تعرف صحته.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses names the Lord of the east and west and what lies between, challenging them to use reason.
rows.anchor: رب المشرق والمغرب وما بينهما إن كنتم تعقلون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Once the argument cornered him, Pharaoh threatened to imprison Moses if he worshipped another god.
rows.anchor: حين لزمته الحجة: { لئن اتخذت إلها غيري لأجعلنك من المسجونين } من المحبوسين في السجن.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The idols worshipped by Abraham's people are his enemies; he opposes and does not worship them, while he worships the Lord of the worlds.
rows.anchor: هذه الآلهة التي تعبدونها عدو لي، أعاديهم أنا ولا أعبدهم { إلا رب العالمين } لكن رب العالمين أعبده.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abraham asks for a good reputation and praise among later generations.
rows.anchor: لسان صدق في الآخرين } أي: ذكرا جميلا، وثناء حسنا في الأمم التي تجيء بعدي.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He asks to inherit Paradise through God's grace and mercy.
rows.anchor: واجعلني } ممن يرث الجنة بفضلك ورحمتك.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sound heart is one free of associating partners with God.
rows.anchor: إلا من أتى الله بقلب سليم } سلم من الشرك.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Paradise is brought near to the God-fearing.
rows.anchor: وأزلفت الجنة } قربت { للمتقين }.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hell is shown to those led astray, meaning the disbelievers.
rows.anchor: وبرزت } وأظهرت { الجحيم للغاوين } للكافرين.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Solomon tells the hoopoe to step back a short distance and watch what answer the queen sends; the hoopoe delivers the letter to her.
rows.anchor: أي: استأخر غير بعيد { فانظر ماذا يرجعون } ما يردون من الجواب، فمضى الهدهد، وألقى إليها الكتاب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The queen calls the letter noble because its contents are good.
rows.anchor: كتاب كريم } حسن ما فيه، ثم بينت ما فيه فقالت:

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: She states that it is from Solomon and begins with “In the name of God, the Most Merciful, the Compassionate.”
rows.anchor: إنه من سليمان وإنه بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Solomon forbids them from exalting themselves over him, even though they are kings, and calls them to come obedient and submitted.
rows.anchor: لا تترفعوا علي وإن كنتم ملوكا { وأتوني مسلمين } طائعين منقادين.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The queen asks her council to advise her and says she will not settle an issue until they attend.
rows.anchor: أفتوني في أمري } بينوا لي ما أعمل { ما كنت قاطعة } قاضية وفاصلة { أمرا حتى تشهدون } حتى تحضرون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The council says they have strength and battle prowess but leaves the decision to the queen and promises obedience; she warns that invading kings devastate towns and abase their nobles, and God confirms that this is how they act.
rows.anchor: نحن أولوا قوة } في القتال { وأولوا بأس شديد } عند الحرب { والأمر إليك } أيتها الملكة { فانظري ماذا تأمرين } نطعك.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The queen reasons that kings who conquer a city destroy it and humiliate its nobles, as a strategy to secure control; God confirms her observation.
rows.anchor: إذا دخلوا قرية } عنوة وغلبة { أفسدوها } خربوها { وجعلوا أعزة أهلها أذلة } أهانوا أشرافها بها؛ ليستقيم لهم الأمر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those God wills are the martyrs; all people come to God humbled.
rows.anchor: إلا من شاء الله } يعني: الشهداء { وكل أتوه } يأتون الله سبحانه { داخرين } صاغرين.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The mountains appear motionless while passing like clouds: an immense object or crowd beyond the eye's capacity seems still to its observer even as it moves.
rows.anchor: كل جمع كثير يقصر عنه الطرف لكثرته فهو في حسبان الناظر واقف وهو يسير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This is God's handiwork, and He has perfected every thing.
rows.anchor: صنع الله } أي: صنع الله ذلك صنعه { الذي أتقن } أحكم { كل شيء }.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The good deed is the declaration that there is no god but God, and good comes to its speaker through it.
rows.anchor: من جاء بالحسنة } وهي كلمة لا إله إلا الله { فله خير منها } فمنها يصل إليه الخير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The evil deed is associating partners with God; its perpetrators are thrown face-first into Hell and receive only what they did.
rows.anchor: ومن جاء بالسيئة } الشرك { فكبت } ألقيت وطرحت { وجوههم في النار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Muhammad is commanded to worship the Lord of Mecca, who made it a protected sanctuary and owns and creates everything.
rows.anchor: إنما أمرت أن أعبد رب هذه البلدة } يعني: مكة { الذي حرمها } جعلها حرما آمنا { وله كل شيء } ملكا وخلقا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If someone strays, Muhammad is to say that his duty is only to convey the warning.
rows.anchor: ومن ضل فقل إنما أنا من المنذرين } أي: ليس علي إلا البلاغ.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The signs God will show the polytheists refer to the Battle of Badr, and God is not unaware of what they do.
rows.anchor: سيريكم آياته } أيها المشركون. يعني: يوم بدر { فتعرفونها وما ربك بغافل بما تعملون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses's sister follows his trail and sees him from a distance without the others realizing she is his sister.
rows.anchor: قصيه } اتبعي أثره، فاتبعته { فبصرت به عن جنب } أبصرته من بعيد { وهم لا يشعرون } أنها أخته.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God prevented Moses from accepting a wet nurse before he was returned to his mother; his sister offers a household that will care for him sincerely.
rows.anchor: منعنا موسى أن يقبل ثدي مرضعة { من قبل } أن نرده على أمه { فقالت } أخته حين تعذر عليهم رضاعة:

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: His sister directed them to his mother, who raised him for Pharaoh's household; they did not know God had promised his mother his return.
rows.anchor: أكثرهم لا يعلمون } آل فرعون كانوا لا يعلمون أن الله وعدها رده عليها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses reached full strength above thirty and maturity at forty; God gave him reason, understanding, and knowledge before prophethood.
rows.anchor: استوى } وبلغ أربعين سنة { آتيناه حكما } عقلا وفهما { وعلما } قبل النبوة.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses entered an Egyptian city at dusk, between sunset and night; an Israelite in his party fought a Copt, his enemy, and asked Moses for help.
rows.anchor: ودخل المدينة } يعني: مدينة بأرض مصر { على حين غفلة من أهلها } فيما بين المغرب والعشاء { فوجد فيها رجلين يقتتلان } أحدهما إسرائيلي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses struck the Copt with his whole hand and killed him unintentionally; he regretted it because he had not been commanded to kill him, called it Satan's work, and asked forgiveness.
rows.anchor: فوكزه موسى } ضربه بجميع كفه { فقضى عليه } فقتله ولم يتعمد قتله، فندم على ذلك لأنه لم يؤمر بقتله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses says that God's favor was forgiveness and vows not to help criminals by assisting in a sin again.
rows.anchor: قال رب بما أنعمت علي } بالمغفرة { فلن أكون ظهيرا للمجرمين } لن أعين بعدها على خطيئة.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses becomes afraid of the Copt he killed and watches for news; the Israelite he helped the previous day calls to him again.
rows.anchor: فأصبح في } تلك { المدينة خائفا } من قتله القبطي { يترقب } ينتظر الأخبار { فإذا } الإسرائيلي { الذي استنصره بالأمس يستصرخه } يستغيثه.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses rebukes the Israelite for inviting him to another fight after yesterday's killing; when Moses approaches, the Israelite mistakes his target and says Moses wants to kill him.
rows.anchor: ظاهر الغواية، قد قتلت بك بالأمس رجلا، وتدعوني إلى آخر، وأقبل إليهما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Israelite's accusation alerts the Copt that Moses killed the Copt the day before; the Copt tells Pharaoh, who orders Moses killed, and a man comes to warn him.
rows.anchor: فلما قال الإسرائيلي هذا علم القبطي أنه قاتل القبطي بالأمس، فأتى فرعون فأخبره بذلك،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The traces of God's mercy are the effects of rain: it makes the dry earth grow again, showing that God can resurrect the dead.
rows.anchor: يعني: آثار المطر الذي هو رحمة الله تعالى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If a wind turns vegetation yellow and dry, disbelievers persist in ingratitude, neither believing nor thanking God for the rain.
rows.anchor: رأوا النبت قد اصفر وجف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The statement that Muhammad cannot make the dead hear was explained in Surat al-Anbiya, and the following verse was explained in Surat al-Naml.
rows.anchor: فإنك لا تسمع الموتى } مضت الاية في سورة الأنبياء، والتي بعدها في سورة النمل.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The deniers of resurrection ask whether they will be created anew after they have become dust and disappeared in the earth.
rows.anchor: يعني: منكري البعث { أإذا ضللنا في الأرض } صرنا ترابا وبطلنا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The angel of death takes people's spirits; “takes you fully” means seizing your souls.
rows.anchor: قل يتوفاكم } يقبض أرواحكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The criminals lower their heads in shame, admit that they now see what they denied and hear the messengers' truth, and ask to return to do good works.
rows.anchor: المجرمون } المشركون { ناكسوا رؤوسهم } مطأطئوها حياء من ربهم عز وجل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's statement that He could give every soul its guidance is followed by a statement addressed to the people of Hell.
rows.anchor: ولو شئنا لآتينا كل نفس هداها } رشدها. الآية. ويقال لأهل النار.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They are told to taste punishment because they abandoned belief in this day; “We forgot you” means God leaves them in the Fire.
rows.anchor: فذوقوا بما نسيتم لقاء يومكم هذا } أي: تركتم الإيمان به { إنا نسيناكم } تركناكم في النار.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “Those who convey God's messages” describes the earlier people; they fear God alone and do not fear human criticism about what God made lawful for them, and God keeps account of creation's deeds.
rows.anchor: ويخشونه ولا يخشون أحدا إلا الله } لا يخشون قالة الناس ولائمتهم فيما أحل الله لهم { وكفى بالله حسيبا } حافظا لأعمال خلقه.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Muhammad is not the father of any of the men, so Zayd is not his son despite adoption; Muhammad is God's messenger and the seal of prophets, with no prophet after him.
rows.anchor: فتقولوا: إنه تزوج امرأة ابنه، يعني: زيدا ليس له بابن وإن كان قد تبناه { ولكن } كان { رسول الله وخاتم النبيين } لا نبي بعده.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Remembering God “much” means never forgetting Him in any circumstance.
rows.anchor: اذكروا الله ذكرا كثيرا } وهو أن لا ينسى على حال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Glorifying God means praying to Him at dawn, afternoon, and the two evening prayers.
rows.anchor: وسبحوه } صلوا له { بكرة } صلاة الفجر { وأصيلا } صلاة العصر والعشاءين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's blessing means that He forgives and has mercy; the angels ask forgiveness, leading believers from ignorance and disbelief to certainty and Islam.
rows.anchor: ليخرجكم من الظلمات إلى النور } من ظلمات الجهل والكفر إلى نور اليقين والإسلام.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Satan's expectation that people would be led astray proved right for everyone except a group of believers, who did not follow him.
rows.anchor: ولقد صدق عليهم إبليس ظنه } الذي ظن بهم من إغوائهم { فاتبعوه إلا فريقا من المؤمنين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Satan had no proof or compelling authority over them; the trial through him makes manifest who believes in the afterlife and who doubts it.
rows.anchor: إلا لنعلم } المعنى: لكن امتحانهم بإبليس لنعلم { من يؤمن بالآخرة ممن هو منها في شك } علم وقوعه منه.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The command to invoke the alleged gods is a threat; they own nothing even as small as an atom, have no share in creation, and did not help God create the heavens and earth, so cannot be His partners.
rows.anchor: من دون الله } وهذا أمر تهديد، ثم وصفهم فقال: { لا يملكون مثقال ذرة في السموات ولا في الأرض

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse also introduces a refutation of the polytheists' claim that their gods intercede with God.
rows.anchor: ثم أبطل قولهم أنهم شفعاؤنا عند الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Whatever charity people give, God replaces it either immediately in this world or later in the next.
rows.anchor: فهو يخلفه } يعطي خلفه؛ إما عاجلا في الدنيا؛ وإما آجلا في الآخرة.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God gathers worshippers and the beings they worship, then questions the angels to rebuke the polytheists.
rows.anchor: ويوم نحشرهم جميعا } العابدين والمعبودين { ثم نقول للملائكة } توبيخا للكفار: { أهؤلاء إياكم كانوا يعبدون }.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The angels declare God their protector and say the polytheists actually worshipped jinn by obeying Iblis and his followers; most believed the jinn's promises.
rows.anchor: أنت ولينا } الذي نتولاه ويتولانا { من دونهم بل كانوا يعبدون الجن } يطيعون إبليس وأعوانه { أكثرهم بهم مؤمنون } مصدقون ما يمنونهم ويعدونهم.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The warning benefits those who follow the Qur'an and act on it, fearing God despite not seeing Him.
rows.anchor: إنما تنذر من اتبع الذكر } إنما ينفع إنذارك من اتبع القرآن فعمل به { وخشي الرحمن بالغيب } خاف الله تعالى ولم يره.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: At resurrection God records people's deeds and their traces, meaning what they leave others to follow.
rows.anchor: ونكتب ما قدموا } من الأعمال { وآثارهم } ما استن به بعدهم.

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Another interpretation takes the recorded traces to mean the steps people take to mosques.
rows.anchor: آثارهم } ما استن به بعدهم. وقيل: خطاهم إلى المساجد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God has counted and clarified everything in the manifest register, the Preserved Tablet.
rows.anchor: وكل شيء أحصيناه } عددناه وبيناه { في إمام مبين } وهو اللوح المحفوظ.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The city in the parable is Antioch, and the messengers were sent by Jesus.
rows.anchor: واضرب لهم مثلا أصحاب القرية } وهي أنطاكية { إذ جاءها المرسلون } رسل عيسى عليه السلام.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Two of Jesus's disciples came first and were rejected, so God strengthened the message with a third messenger.
rows.anchor: إذ أرسلنا إليهم اثنين } من الحواريين { فكذبوهما فعززنا بثالث } قوينا الرسالة برسول ثالث.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The people of Paradise receive whatever they wish, as well as peace spoken by God Himself.
rows.anchor: سلام } أي: لهم سلام { قولا } يقوله الله عز وجل قولا.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: On that day the criminals are separated from the believers.
rows.anchor: وامتازوا اليوم أيها المجرمون } أي: انفردوا عن المؤمنين.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's covenant with Adam's descendants means His command not to worship Satan, who is their manifest enemy.
rows.anchor: ألم أعهد إليكم } ألم آمركم { يا بني آدم أن لا تعبدوا الشيطان إنه لكم عدو مبين }.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The answer is yes: they will be raised, humbled and abased.
rows.anchor: قل نعم } تبعثون { وأنتم داخرون } صاغرون أذلاء.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The resurrection is one cry, after which they are alive and see.
rows.anchor: فإنما هي } يعني: القيامة { زجرة } صيحة { واحدة فإذا هم } أحياء { ينظرون } سوء أعمالهم.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sight can be understood as seeing the evil of their deeds.
rows.anchor: واحدة فإذا هم } أحياء { ينظرون } سوء أعمالهم.

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Another reported interpretation is that they see what they had denied.
rows.anchor: ينظرون } سوء أعمالهم. وقيل: ما كذبوا به.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Day of Judgment repays them for their deeds and separates truth from falsehood.
rows.anchor: هذا يوم الدين } يوم نجازى فيه بما عملنا. { هذا يوم الفصل } بين الحق والباطل.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “Those who did wrong” means disbelievers; their counterparts are their satanic companions and idols, and the angels are told to lead them to Hell.
rows.anchor: احشروا الذين ظلموا } كفروا { أزواجهم } قرناءهم من الشياطين وأوثانهم. { فاهدوهم } دلوهم إلى النار.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They are detained and questioned about their words and deeds; they cannot help one another and instead surrender.
rows.anchor: وقفوهم } احبسوهم { إنهم مسؤولون } عن أقوالهم وأفعالهم. { مالكم لا تناصرون } لا ينصر بعضكم بعضا.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The followers and leaders turn toward one another and dispute.
rows.anchor: وأقبل بعضهم على بعض } يعني: الأتباع والرؤساء { يتساءلون } يتخاصمون.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The followers say their leaders overpowered them from the religious side and led them away from it.
rows.anchor: قالوا } يعني: الأتباع للرؤساء { إنكم كنتم تأتوننا عن اليمين } تقهروننا بالقوة من قبل الدين، فتضلونا عنه.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The drink in Paradise is flowing wine, white and pleasant, with no illness or pain and no loss of reason.
rows.anchor: لا فيها غول } داء ولا وجع { ولا هم عنها ينزفون } لا تذهب بعقولهم.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The women look only at their husbands and have large eyes.
rows.anchor: وعندهم قاصرات الطرف } نساء لا ينظرن إلى غير أزواجهن { عين } نجل العيون.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They resemble sheltered ostrich eggs in the clarity of their color, hidden beneath ostrich feathers.
rows.anchor: كأنهن بيض } في صفاء لونها { مكنون } يستره ريش النعام.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The people of Paradise turn to one another and ask about what they experienced.
rows.anchor: فأقبل بعضهم } يعني: أهل الجنة { على بعض يتساءلون } عما مر بهم.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One of them recalls the companion whose story is told in Surat al-Kahf, who asked whether he believed in resurrection and recompense; “are we to be repaid?” means judged and recompensed.
rows.anchor: قال قائل منهم إني كان لي قرين } يعني: الذين قص الله خبرهما في سورة الكهف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God asks the people of Paradise whether they will look; the Muslim looks and sees his unbelieving companion in the middle of Hell.
rows.anchor: قال } الله سبحانه لأهل الجنة: { هل أنتم مطلعون } إلى النار. { فاطلع } المسلم فرأى قرينه الكافر { في سواء الجحيم } وسطه، فقال له:

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Night and day roll into one another.
rows.anchor: ويكور الليل على النهار } أي: يدخل أحدهما على الآخر.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Humanity was created from Adam and his spouse Eve; livestock were sent down as eight pairs, explained in Surat al-An'am.
rows.anchor: خلقكم من نفس واحدة } يعني: آدم عليه السلام { ثم جعل منها زوجها } حواء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Human creation proceeds through sperm, then a clinging clot, then a lump, in three darknesses: the abdomen, womb, and placenta; this should turn people to God's worship.
rows.anchor: أي: نطفة، ثم علقة، ثم مضغة { في ظلمات ثلاث } ظلمة البطن، وظلمة الرحم، وظلمة المشيمة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God does not approve disbelief among His sincere believing servants, as in the example of His servants who drink from a spring.
rows.anchor: ولا يرضى لعباده الكفر } أي: المؤمنين المخلصين منهم، كقوله: { عينا يشرب بها عباد الله }.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If people obey and thank God, He accepts their gratitude and rewards them for it.
rows.anchor: وإن تشكروا } أي: إن تطيعوا ربكم { يرضه لكم } يرض الشكر لكم ويثبكم عليه.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God commanded Muhammad to worship Him sincerely, meaning as a monotheist.
rows.anchor: قل إني أمرت أن أعبد الله مخلصا له الدين } أي: موحدا.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He was commanded to be the first Muslim from this community.
rows.anchor: وأمرت لأن أكون أول المسلمين } من هذه الأمة.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The greeting to the people entering Paradise says they were good in worldly life.
rows.anchor: طبتم } أي: كنتم طيبين في الدنيا.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The inherited land is the land of Paradise; they make their homes wherever they wish there, and this is the reward of the obedient.
rows.anchor: وأورثنا الأرض } أي: أرض الجنة { نتبوأ من الجنة } نتخذ منها منازل { حيث نشاء فنعم أجر العاملين } ثواب المطيعين.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The angels encircle the Throne, judgment is made between the people of Paradise and Hell, and praise is declared to God, Lord of the worlds.
rows.anchor: وترى الملائكة حافين من حول العرش } محيطين به { وقضي بينهم } أي: حكم بين أهل الجنة والنار. { وقيل الحمد لله رب العالمين }.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's decree that the disbelievers are people of the Fire refers to His statement that He will fill Hell with Iblis and his followers.
rows.anchor: لأملأن جهنم منك وممن تبعك...

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The angels bearing and surrounding the Throne seek forgiveness for believers; the prayer that God's mercy and knowledge encompass everything means His mercy reaches all and He knows all.
rows.anchor: ربنا وسعت كل شيء رحمة وعلما } أي: وسعت رحمتك كل شيء، وعلمت كل شيء.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Calling on God sincerely with religion means sincerely offering obedience to Him.
rows.anchor: فادعوا الله مخلصين له الدين } الطاعة.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God raises the ranks of the people rewarded in Paradise; He owns and created the Throne and sends revelation, which gives hearts life from disbelief, to whom He chooses as messenger to warn of Resurrection, when earthly and heavenly people meet.
rows.anchor: يلقي الروح } الوحي الذي تحيا به القلوب من موت الكفر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: On Resurrection Day people emerge from their graves and nothing of their deeds or wealth is hidden from God; He asks who owns sovereignty and answers: God, the One, the All-Prevailing.
rows.anchor: يقول الله في ذلك اليوم: { لمن الملك اليوم } ثم يجيب نفسه { لله الواحد القهار }.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The people ask to see Iblis and Cain, the first to institute misguidance, so they can put them underfoot in Hell's lowest depth.
rows.anchor: يعنون: إبليس وقابيل؛ لأنهما أول من سن الضلالة { نجعلهما تحت أقدامنا ليكونا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who profess God as Lord and remain steadfast hold to monotheism without any association; angels descend at death, telling them not to fear their sins or grieve over them because God forgives.
rows.anchor: إن الذين قالوا ربنا الله } أي: وحدوه { ثم استقاموا } على التوحيد، فلم يشركوا به شيئا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The angels who guarded and accompanied them in worldly life say they are their allies in both worlds and will not leave until they usher them into Paradise.
rows.anchor: يقولون لهم: لن نفارقكم [في القيامة] حتى ندخلكم الجنة.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In Paradise, the believers will have everything they desire and ask for.
rows.anchor: ولكم فيها ما تدعون } تتمنون وتسألون.

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: One interpretation of the best speech is that it describes the Prophet Muhammad, who called people to God's oneness.
rows.anchor: قيل: هو رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم؛ لأنه دعا إلى توحيد الله.

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Another reported interpretation says this verse was revealed about callers to prayer.
rows.anchor: وقيل: إنها نزلت في المؤذنين.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The creation of the heavens, earth, and creatures spread through them are signs of God's power; He can gather them for Resurrection whenever He wills.
rows.anchor: ومن آياته } دلائل قدرته { خلق السموات والأرض وما بث } فرق ونشر { فيهما من دابة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Misfortune is punishment for people's wrongdoing, though God forgives much and does not requite it.
rows.anchor: فبما كسبت أيديكم } فهي جزاء ما اكتسبتم من الإجرام { ويعفوا عن كثير } فلا يجازي عليه.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People cannot escape God by fleeing anywhere on earth.
rows.anchor: هربا، اي: إن هربتم لم تعجزوا الله في أخذكم.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ships running on the sea like mountains are signs; if God stops the wind they remain still and motionless, signs for every patient, grateful believer.
rows.anchor: ومن آياته الجوار } السفن التي تجري { في البحر كالأعلام } كالجبال في العظم.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God can sink ships and their passengers because of their sins, yet He forgives much and does not punish it.
rows.anchor: أو يوبقهن } يهلكهن، يعني: أهلها { بما كسبوا } من الذنوب { ويعف عن كثير } فلا يعاقب عليها.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who argue against God's signs to refute them will learn there is no escape from His punishment.
rows.anchor: ويعلم الذين يجادلون في آياتنا } أي: في دفعها وإبطالها { ما لهم من محيص } مهرب من عذاب الله.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Each sign shown was greater than the one before it; God punished them with famine, flood, locusts, and other trials so they might abandon disbelief.
rows.anchor: وما نريهم من آية إلا هي أكبر من أختها } قرينتها وصاحبتها التي كانت قبلها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They call Moses “sorcerer” by the title they had already given him, ask him to pray to God to remove the torment from believers, promise faith, then break their promise once it is removed.
rows.anchor: ادع لنا ربك بما عهد عندك } فيمن آمن به من كشف العذاب عنه { إننا لمهتدون } أي: مؤمنون. { فلما كشفنا عنهم العذاب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Pharaoh says the rivers flow beneath him by his command.
rows.anchor: وهذه الأنهار تجري من تحتي } بأمري. وقيل: من تحت قصوري.

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: An alternative says the rivers flow beneath Pharaoh's palaces.
rows.anchor: وهذه الأنهار تجري من تحتي } بأمري. وقيل: من تحت قصوري.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Pharaoh claims to be better than Moses, whom he calls lowly and weak and says can scarcely speak clearly because of his speech impediment.
rows.anchor: بل أنا { خير من هذا الذي هو مهين } حقير ضعيف، يعني: موسى. { ولا يكاد يبين } يفصح بكلامه لعيه.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Pharaoh argues that a true leader should have gold bracelets, a sign of authority, or angels accompanying him as witnesses.
rows.anchor: ألقي عليه أسورة من ذهب } حلي بأساور الذهب إن كان رئيسا مطاعا؟ والطوق والسوار من الذهب كان من علامة الرئاسة عندهم.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Each community means all adherents of a religion, gathered together for judgment.
rows.anchor: وترى كل أمة } كل أهل دين { جاثية } مجتمعة للحساب.

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Another interpretation says they are kneeling from the terror of that day.
rows.anchor: جاثية } مجتمعة للحساب. وقيل: جالسة على الركب من هول ذلك اليوم.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “This is Our book” means the register of the recording angels; God ordered them to copy what people did.
rows.anchor: هذا كتابنا ينطق } أي: ديوان الحفظة { إنا كنا نستنسخ } نأمر بنسخ { ما كنتم تعملون }.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Pregnancy and childbirth are burdensome; the total of thirty months for pregnancy and nursing implies a minimum six-month pregnancy and two years of nursing, followed by weaning.
rows.anchor: وحمله وفصاله ثلاثون شهرا } أقل الحمل ستة أشهر، والفصال: الفطام، ويكون ذلك بعد حولين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A person's full maturity is thirty-three years, and forty years marks another milestone.
rows.anchor: حتى إذا بلغ أشده } غاية شبابه، وهي ثلاث وثلاثون سنة { وبلغ أربعين سنة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The prayer was revealed about Abu Bakr: at forty he believed in the Prophet, and both his parents believed; he thanks God for the gift of faith to himself and them.
rows.anchor: نزلت في أبي بكر رضي الله عنه، وذلك أنه لما بلغ أربعين سنة آمن بالنبي صلى الله عليه وسلم، وآمن أبواه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abu Bakr asks for believing descendants, and God answered by making his children Muslim; no other Companion had parents, sons, and daughters who all accepted Islam.
rows.anchor: فأسلموا، ولم يكن أحد من الصحابة أسلم هو وأبواه وبنوه وبناته إلا أبو بكر رضي الله عنه.
